brief:
The United States has designated Palestine Action, a British protest organization, as a terrorist group, Drop Site News reported. The move represents a significant expansion of Washington's counterterrorism framework to encompass activism centered on Palestinian affairs.

An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent was released from a jail in Texas following his detention. The circumstances surrounding the agent's release and the reasons for his initial imprisonment were not immediately detailed in available reports.

Russia issued threats to strike military targets within the United Kingdom, escalating rhetoric between Moscow and London. The threat followed broader tensions between Russia and Western nations over support for Ukraine and other geopolitical disputes.
title: U.S. designates UK's Palestine Action as terrorist group
